4823-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3652-3967-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-3967-5006-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ornithopter, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

1479-2841-6926-8293.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-8293.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Cleveland Booker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2921-4454.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2921-4454.description:
Cast Bond of Revival by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Bond of Revival.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Bond of Revival
Resolve the Bond of Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-6255--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-6255--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-728-7212.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Creakwood Safewright.
When Creakwood Safewright dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

5184-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1451-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
1451-2034-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

1183-2744-2757.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
When the Pentavite enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6156-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

465-3742-4251-4875-7060.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4639-5475-7014.notablePrerequisites: North Pole Patrol and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
4639-5475-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
North Pole Patrol triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Forensic Researcher triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.

522-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Melira.
When Melira dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4210-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4210-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3933-4929-5479-6774.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3933-4929-5479-6774.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

7-4050-4484-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-4050-4484-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4050-4484-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-4050-4484-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1329-3750-5407-6447.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has exactly 6 power and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1329-3750-5407-6447.description:
If The Aetherspark is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast The Aetherspark from your graveyard this turn.
Cast The Aetherspark either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {4}.
Activate Brass Squire by tapping it, attaching The Aetherspark to a creature you control that has exactly 6 power.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has The Aetherspark attached, triggering The Aetherspark, putting six loyalty counters on it.
Activate The Aetherspark's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, adding ten {R}.
The Aetherspark is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having 0 loyalty.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

2334-2724-3080-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

1806-2034-4666-5997.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Planar Void triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Alien Warrior and Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

880-3703-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-3703-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1799-2579-5296.manaNeeded: {1} if Workhorse has exactly one +1/+1 counter on it
1799-2579-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat step 1 until Workhorse dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Workhorse from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Workhorse from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its static effect.
Repeat.

708-2292-2459-2500.description:
Pay {2} to Mirage Mirror to have it become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Rograkh, returning Rograkh to the command zone.
When Rograkh enters the command zone, both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 2.

4067-4481-5467.notablePrerequisites:
Wylie Duke does not have summoning sickness.
Heavy Arbalest attached to Wylie Duke.
4067-4481-5467.description:
Activate Wylie Duke by tapping it.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Resolve the Wylie Duke ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Wylie Duke.
Repeat.

2034-3433-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Hornet Queen that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Hornet Queen token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Insects, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1012-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

414-4381-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-4381-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

803-2034-3627.notablePrerequisites:
Avacyn's Collar attached to any creature you control.
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2034-3627.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Avacyn's Collar attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Avacyn's Collar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Avacyn's Collar's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Repeat.

580-2034-2105-4068-5003.description:
Declare the Combat Celebrant and Savior of Ollenbock as an attacker, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant and Savior of Ollenbock triggers.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Savior of Ollenbock triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Combat Celebrant, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Savior of Ollenbock triggers, putting a +1/+! counter on itself and exiling Combat Celebrant from your graveyard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Savior of Ollenbock, adding {C}{C}.
Savior of Ollenbock dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle and Savior of Ollenbock.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Savior of Ollenbock from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Savior of Ollenbock trigger, putting Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2178-3590.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Warchanter Skald.
You control at least four additional Dwarf and/or Berserker creatures.
2034-2178-3590.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald using the Thornbite Staff ability by paying {2} and tapping it.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creates a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Resolve Warchanter Skald's activated ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Dwarf Berserker to add {C}{C}.
Warchanter Skald's ability from Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

404-1849-2105-4663.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block your creatures.
404-1849-2105-4663.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R}.
Combat Celebrant enters the battlefield, triggering Bramble Sovereign, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
Proceed to your combat phase, and declare Ghired and Combat Celebrant as attackers.
Ghired triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Exert Combat Celebrant, untapping all other creatures you control and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 4.
